{{Top}}
[[File:Star_Wars_RPG_Glowrod.jpg|thumb|A glowrod]]
{{Quote|What's the difference between a lightsaber and a glowrod? A lightsaber impresses girls!|Jacen Solo|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>}}
The '''glowrod''', also referred to as a '''glowtube''', '''glowlight''', '''glowlamp''', '''light stick''', '''flashlight''', '''chemlight''',<ref name="SWGROTW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> '''glow stick''',<ref name="SWGROTW" /> '''glowpole''',<ref name="TAS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref> or '''luma''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a device utilized for the purpose of producing light.

==Characteristics==
Glowrods were portable illumination sources that generated light using either phosphorescent chemicals or [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]]. Glow rods that used chemical reactants were disposed of once the chemicals were expended. Costing about ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], the light intensity could be controlled by a dial that determined how much of the reactant was used up during operation. These glow rods were about six [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long and shaped like [[Stylus/Legends|styluses]], weighed about twenty [[gram]]s, and had clips that could be used to attach them to [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] or [[Belt/Legends|belts]]. They could operate for up to fifty [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] and the light from them could reach up to twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Glow rods that relied on power cells had longer ranges and could provide illumination for up to one hundred hours. They cost twenty-five credits to purchase, and the power cells could be recharged up to fifty times. These glow rods varied in size from personal use devices to industrial use [[spot-luma]]s. [[Lerrimore Contracting Company]] manufactured the heavy-duty [[industrial glow rod]], which was commonly used during construction and [[Mining/Legends|mining]].<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
[[Soldier/Legends|Soldiers]] often affixed glow rods to their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], mounted them to the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. They served as makeshift torches, but had the side effect of making the soldiers more visible to enemy soldiers and [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]].<ref name="EGWT" /> It was a standard issue item given to [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. They also came in versions that could be switched to [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]].<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>

A glowrod could be modified so that it flickered instead of emitting a constant light so that it would resemble the flickering of torchlight.<ref name="TAS" />

The Chemlight was activated by breaking the stick in half, providing two lights.

The [[Glo-Long]] company was widely considered the finest manufacturer of glow sticks in the galaxy.<ref name="SWGROTW" />

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Glowrods seem to be Star Wars Universe-adaptations to real-world flashlights and glow-sticks.
